08 / BEYOND THE KEYBOARD

More than
a résumé.

Life doesn’t stop at the keyboard.

01
↗

On the road

Half-marathons, marathons, and the miles in between. I recently started distance running as a hobby and have one half-marathon under my belt. I hope to continue this hobby and participate in more races in the future.

02
3W–2L

In the ring

I boxed competitively for five years. I ended my amateur career with a 3–2 record, along with a few off-the-record exhibition fights.

03
08 YEARS

On the stage

I played French horn for eight years and mellophone for four years in marching band. The highlight of my music career was the year I participated in the Georgia All-State Band. I had tried out every year that I played French horn and finally made it in 2017 after several years of failed attempts.
